principle_violations.reason: The Circle and Square classes throw UnsupportedOperationException for the volume method, which violates LSP. Subtypes should be replaceable for their supertypes without altering the desirable properties.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the volume behavior into a different interface so that only classes that actually have a volume implement it.

principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class is responsible for calculating the area, but it also unnecessarily prints the list of shapes, which deviates from a single responsibility.
principle_violations.suggestion: Remove the print statement from the AreaCalculator constructor.

principle_violations.reason: The Shape interface forces all implementing classes to define a volume method, even if some shapes are 2D and don't have a volume.
principle_violations.suggestion: Define two interfaces: Shape2D for shapes without volume and Shape3D for shapes with volume.

overall_feedback: 3 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
